ffff_framework.findings_goal: Study existing hustle wormbucket provisioning (07-auto-spawn-worm-bucket.sh); existing B2 account structure; customer nickname schemes
ffff_framework.flags_goal: MISSING: no B2 provisioning script that respects COC-compliant bucket scheme; MISSING: no immutable backup script with customer nicknames
ffff_framework.flow_goal: Two parallel flows: (A) Request→bucket creation→creds→COC logging→test; (B) Snapshot→tar.gz→hash→B2 upload→metadata logging
ffff_framework.friction_goal: B2 rate limits, WORM enforcement 24h delay, manual credential setup, no automated recovery

critical_context.coc_requirements: Buckets must enforce WORM on forensics/, versioning on pollen/, auto-delete temp files after 90d; all provisioning logged to COC
critical_context.customer_scheme: Bucket naming: faerie-{customer-nickname}-{purpose}-{date}; credentials scoped per project (read-only for auditors, write for sync)

part_a_b2_provisioning.input: COC-compliant config (name, access policy, WORM enforcement)
process: Create B2 bucket with customer nickname embedded
Set lifecycle: WORM on forensics/, versioning on pollen/, delete after 90d on temp
Set up replication from local forensics/ to B2
part_a_b2_provisioning.output: Terraform/CloudFormation config + bucket URL + credentials file

part_b_immutable_backup.input: Local repo path + customer nickname + backup schedule
process: Create tar.gz snapshot of entire folder (NOT git metadata)
part_b_immutable_backup.output: Backup manifest + recovery instructions + bucket URL

success_criteria.config_templates: Terraform and YAML templates for bucket lifecycle policies
success_criteria.coc_integration: Both scripts write COC entries via unified COC writer (from Phase 1)
success_criteria.recovery_playbook: Step-by-step guide to restore from backup using metadata
success_criteria.compass_edge: S if scripts are production-ready; E if uncertain about rate-limit handling; W if conflicts with existing provisioning
